statement: The target_system field on certificate a3a5ad8f-0418-4d63-ae7b-85b39973a25b reads "Coinbase". That value was operator-entered free text during a test of the audit tool by the DJZS operator. Coinbase did not submit the audited intent, did not authorize the use of its name, and had no involvement in the audit. The verdict evaluated a test intent authored by the operator and states nothing about any Coinbase system, product, agent, or reasoning.

Through 2026-09-13, target_system was an unauthenticated free-text field on every DJZS certificate. Every value in that field on certificates minted before this record — including this one — is unverified and is not a claim about the named party. From this record forward, target_system is populated only from a claim signed by the subject address and is otherwise null; unsigned historical values render as unverified:<value> on every DJZS surface and are excluded from reputation aggregation. A signed claim binds a name to the paying address; it does not verify that the signer is the named party, and DJZS surfaces state that distinction.
The original certificate is not deleted; Irys does not permit deletion, and the record of the error is part of the record.
